statue.abstract.physical: Top-down view of the abstract sculpture: thick interlocking deep blue tinted electrochromic glass loops on a solid round dark gunmetal chromalloy base disc.

statue.carving.physical: Top-down view of a small grey titanium scrap sculpture on a squat base: a rough human shape, head at the top.

statue.figure.physical: Top-down view of the statue: a square black carbon-weave plinth with a bronze ceramet alloy standing figure, head and shoulders central, raised arm reaching to one side.

statue.holo.physical: Top-down view of the holo-sculpture: a round black carbon-weave plinth with a ceramet alloy emitter ring, a pale glowing shape hovering above its centre.

still.vat.physical: Top-down view of a fermentation tank: a wide round blue-grey moulded polymer vat bound with dark anodised alloy hoops, a closed lid and a single paddle laid across the top.

stool.bar.physical: Top-down view of a tall counter stool: a round orange moulded polymer seat over a grey duralloy footrest ring.

stool.ottoman.physical: Top-down view of a padded gel pouf: a square pale blue aerogel top with buttoned tufts and short graphite ceramet alloy feet at the corners.

stool.plain.physical: Top-down view of a small pedestal stool: a round grey titanium seat, the tips of its legs just showing.

stove.food_synth.physical: Top-down view of a food synthesiser: a squat white plasteel box against the top edge, a transparisteel hatch and glowing menu panel facing the bottom.

stove.galley.physical: Top-down view of a wide galley unit against the top wall: a gunmetal duralloy counter with two flush induction pads, a recessed food slot, and a glowing grey plasteel control strip along the back edge.

table.coffee.physical: Top-down view of a low table: a long clear aluminium glass top with a lower shelf showing beneath.

table.dining.physical: Top-down view of a square dining table: a grey polycarbonate top with a runner down the middle, one leg at each corner.

table.long.physical: Top-down view of a very long wardroom table: a pale blue aerogel top twice as long as it is wide, a line of serving dishes down the middle.

table.mess.physical: Top-down view of a long mess table: an orange anodised alloy top with a raised rim, bolted feet showing at the corners.

table.plank.physical: Top-down view of a plain fold-down table: a rectangular grey titanium top, twice as wide as it is deep, legs at the corners.

table.round_small.physical: Top-down view of a small pedestal table: a round grey polycarbonate top on a single central post.

table.side.physical: Top-down view of a small square accent table: an opaque white smart glass top with a bevelled edge, slim chrome polished chromalloy legs at the corners.

throne.gilded.physical: Top-down view of a richly ornate crystal throne: crystal-clear diamond glass frame with flared arms, a pearl graphene composite seat, a fan-shaped back along the top edge.

throne.state.physical: Top-down view of a grand command throne: a white memory polymer seat between heavy silver polished chromalloy arms, a tall crested back along the top edge.

toilet.sanitation.physical: Top-down view of a sleek sanitation unit: a smooth wall-hung black nanocarbon bowl with no visible cistern, a crystal-clear diamond glass control panel glowing softly on the top wall.

toilet.standard.physical: Top-down view of a waste unit: an oval dark grey duralloy toilet bowl with a dark rim, the seat raised against a rectangular cistern on the top wall, a blue-grey paper roll on the cistern.

utility.generator.physical: Top-down view of a boxy power node: a grey duralloy casing with vents along the top, a fuel cap and pull handle on one side, cables snaking off the top edge.

utility.ladder.physical: Top-down view of a folded access ladder: two long grey duralloy rails with rungs between them, a paint-spattered top step.

utility.mop_bucket.physical: Top-down view of a mop bucket: a round dark grey plasteel bucket of murky water with a wringer at one side, a short dark grey titanium handle laid across the bucket, kept inside the square.

wardrobe.armoire.physical: Top-down view of a massive dressing unit two cells wide: charcoal carbon-weave top edged with carved moulding and clear smart glass inlay, doors along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

wardrobe.narrow.physical: Top-down view of a slim fold-out closet: square orange moulded polymer top, a single door along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

wardrobe.standard.physical: Top-down view of a clothes closet two cells wide: flat grey polycarbonate top with a hatbox at one end, double doors with duralloy handles along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

workbench.cutting_table.physical: Top-down view of a pattern table: a smooth clear polycarbonate top with a length of grey polycarbonate spread across it, shears, chalk and pins, a rack of bolts along the top edge.

workbench.fabrication.physical: Top-down view of a fabrication bench: a pearl memory polymer work surface with a glowing grid, a folded polished chromalloy manipulator arm at the top-left, tool cradles and a small display along the top edge.

workbench.rough.physical: Top-down view of a scrap-plate bench: a long grey stamped duralloy plank top resting on two scrap alloy supports, a few loose tools and shavings on it, a strip of nails along the top edge.

workbench.steel.physical: Top-down view of an utility bench: a white moulded polymer work surface on a grey duralloy frame, a bench vise at one corner, a pegboard of tools along the top edge.

workbench.welding.physical: Top-down view of a bonding bench: a thick grey titanium slab top with clamps and scorch marks, a gas bottle and coiled hose at the top-right corner, a white plasteel spark curtain along the top edge.
